title: Triple collet-set round diamond hoop earrings, 18K gold
subtitle: The collet is the oldest setting form in fine jewellery — a ring of metal that holds the stone precisely without obscuring it. The Triple Hoop sets 18 diamonds in collets across three continuous arcs: each stone held singly, each entered from every direction, three rows of light that move as one piece on the ear. The collet here is not historical reference; it is the right setting for what these diamonds are asked to do.
